svg.title: Clean and modular code from the very first incantation. …and the house points stand as follows: Architecture that keeps the balance. Clean Architecture, SOLID and MVI, with layer rules enforced by tests, not by code-review mood. (+50 RAVENCLAW) Testing potions for safe experiments. Turbine for Flows, virtual time for coroutines, and fakes or mocks, whichever fits the test. (+50 SLYTHERIN) Modular by design. Pure commonMain, platform code behind expect/actual, and convention plugins so many modules build like one. (+60 HUFFLEPUFF) Clarity above all. Code is read far more often than it's written: by my team, by future me, and now by agents too. (+10 RAVENCLAW) Agents earn their merges. Spec → contracts → code → gates → PR. No receipt, no “tests pass”, however confident the agent sounds. (+1000 GRYFFINDOR)
svg.text: // …and the house points stand as follows:
